Stratified Miettinen-Nurminen CI for the difference of incidence rates

Source: R/eair.r
ks_eairdiff_strata_mn.Rd

Stratified version of ks_eairdiff_mn: pools evidence across strata using inverse-variance-like weights and returns a single CI for the common rate difference.

Usage

ks_eairdiff_strata_mn(n1, n2, T1, T2, alpha = 0.05)

Arguments

n1, n2

Numeric vectors of event counts per stratum (Test, Control).

T1, T2

Numeric vectors of person-time per stratum (Test, Control). All four vectors must have the same length.

alpha

Significance level for the two-sided CI. Default 0.05.

Value

A named numeric vector of length 3: delta (point estimate), lcl (lower bound), ucl (upper bound).

Details

Each stratum \(j\) contributes a weight \(W_j = (\tilde\lambda_{1j} / (\tilde\lambda_{2j} T_{1j}) + 1/T_{2j})^{-1}\) and the combined score statistic is \(\sum_j W_j^2 V_j^{-1} \cdot (\sum_j W_j (r_{1j} - r_{2j} - \theta))^2\).

The point estimate delta is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the stratum-specific rate differences.

Strata with NA in any of their inputs are silently dropped via na.rm = TRUE in the stratum sums.

References

Miettinen O, Nurminen M (1985). Comparative analysis of two rates. Statistics in Medicine, 4(2), 213–226.

See also

ks_eairdiff_mn

Examples

## Two strata
ks_eairdiff_strata_mn(
  n1 = c(10,  5),
  n2 = c( 5,  3),
  T1 = c(100, 80),
  T2 = c(100, 70)
)
#>       delta         lcl         ucl 
#>  0.03482143 -0.01869878  0.09902783 

## Single stratum — equivalent to ks_eairdiff_mn() up to point estimate
ks_eairdiff_strata_mn(n1 = 10, n2 = 5, T1 = 100, T2 = 100)
#>       delta         lcl         ucl 
#>  0.05000000 -0.02953395  0.13962995 

## 90 %% CI
ks_eairdiff_strata_mn(
  n1 = c(10, 5), n2 = c(5, 3),
  T1 = c(100, 80), T2 = c(100, 70),
  alpha = 0.10
)
#>        delta          lcl          ucl 
#>  0.034821429 -0.008756036  0.088051785
